text:
tara: Heads-up — PR #482 in the docs repo updates the 429 troubleshooting section but it left an old Python SDK snippet and a dead link to the fallback playbook. Can someone pick up link fixes + snippet validation?

mike: I can take the snippet validation. Which SDK versions do we need to test against?

tara: Thanks — current snippet shows python v1.4.0. Please validate v1.3.x and v1.4.x, and add a TypeScript/JS example for the new unified SDK v2 pattern.

josh: @mike I’ll do a quick link sweep. Found a broken /runbooks/429 -> 404 and the runtime fallback heading got renamed so several anchors are stale.

ryan: FYI runtime changed the 429 fallback ordering last week to prefer regional model variants before spinning up dedicated capacity. Docs should explicitly call out the new ordering and include a tiny policy example.

mike: Quick code check locally — the original snippet relies on implicit retries which hides 429 semantics. I’ll replace it with an explicit backoff example. Example I’ll put in PR:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="${REDWOOD_API_KEY}")
resp = client.generate(prompt="hello", max_tokens=20)
print(resp.text)
```

docs-bot: PR #482 updated, label docs/needs-qa added.

tara: Can we aim to merge by EOD Friday? If someone can't, tag and we’ll reassign.

josh: Link sweep PR up — fixed /runbooks/429 redirect, updated anchors, and added a redirect rule for the old fallback section.

mike: Snippet patch pushed: explicit retry with exponential backoff + jitter, and a note calling out 429 vs 503 differences. Running local tests now; will add CI job to run snippets matrix.

ryan: I’ll draft the policy snippet. Something short like:
```yaml
fallback_order: [regional_variant, dedicated_pool, hosted_fallback]
max_fallback_attempts: 2
```

tara: Perfect — prefer the explicit backoff example + the new policy snippet. Also add a short sentence about observable signals (429 spikes vs qps throttles) so customers know when to adjust batching/kv-cache.

mike: All done — tests pass locally, CI job added to docs-snippet-checker. Pushed changes to the PR.

josh: Link fix deployed to the docs preview. Anchors working.

tara: Thanks everyone. I’ll do a final editorial pass after CI is green and merge. :thumbsup:

mike: If anyone wants me to split the python/ts samples into separate files for easier reuse, I can follow up with a small cleanup PR.
tara: Please do that after this lands — smaller follow-up is fine.
